forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.explanation: Enter your work email and we will send a six-digit code if the address belongs to an account.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to an account, a six-digit code is on its way.
forgot.tooMany: Too many requests from this network. Try again in a few minutes.

error.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
error.locked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Use the unlock link sent to your email.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this network. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.explanation: Your account exists, and an administrator has to approve it before you can sign in.
pending.nextStep: You will receive an email when it is approved. Nobody can see fraud data until then.

register.approvalNotice: An administrator approves every account before it can sign in.
register.failed: The account could not be created. Check the form and try again.

problem.name: Use letters, and hyphens or apostrophes between parts.
problem.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
problem.phone: This is not a valid number for the country selected.
problem.password: This password does not meet the rules below.
problem.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
problem.employeeIdTaken: This employee ID is already registered.

register.roleNotice: An administrator decides the role you are granted.
register.title: Create an account

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.codeExplanation: Enter the code from the email, with the address you asked from.
reset.codeRefused: That code is not right, or it has expired.
reset.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.refused: The password could not be changed. Check the rules and try again.

unlock.title: Unlock your account
unlock.unlocked: Your account is unlocked. You can sign in again.
unlock.expired: This unlock link has expired or has already been used.
unlock.refused: This unlock link is not valid.
unlock.missing: This link is missing its unlock code. Open the link from the email again.
